summary: Harden symlink ancestors, float overflow, surrogates, RFC3339 dates, and acceptance repo patterns

delivery.outcome: Harden symlink-ancestor and (st_dev, st_ino) regular-file checks, float overflow and UTF-16 surrogate rejection, C0/DEL/C1/whitespace safe_path checks, strict ASCII RFC3339 calendar/UTC timestamps, and dot-segment repository pattern parity across models/acceptance.schema.json and operations/.
nonGoals: No wire-schema breaking changes for valid manifests or acceptance claims.

architecture.decision: Enforce lexical symlink-ancestor walks and (st_dev, st_ino) parity in report_io.py, extract local_conformance.py (< 500 lines), reject 1e309 float overflow and lone UTF-16 surrogates in decode(), share strict ASCII YYYY-MM-DD and RFC3339 UTC timestamp validation across acceptance_conformance.py and conformance.py, and align repository dot-segment rejection in acceptance.schema.json.
architecture.rollback: Revert models/acceptance.schema.json and operations/*.py to acceptedBaseSha.
